title: cerastium semidecandrum var. macilentum
intro: Cerastium semidecandrum var. macilentum, commonly known as Snow-in-summer, is a low-growing, mat-forming, flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. The health benefits of Snow-in-summer include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be beneficial in treating wounds and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Snow-in-summer include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential uses.
